fields.article_title: My Experience at Airport by Audriana Ankomah
fields.introduction:
Traveling through the airport was one of the most exciting and educational experiences I have
ever had. The trip gave me the opportunity to observe how airport operations are carried out
and how passengers are handled professionally from arrival to departure.

On the day of the trip, we arrived at the airport early in the morning. The environment was very
busy, with passengers checking in, airport staff assisting travelers, and aircraft moving on the
runway. The atmosphere was energetic and organized.
